messages:
rachel: Proposal: tighten postmortem follow-ups to stop churn. Key pieces: mandatory single owner + SLA, 30/60/90 checkpoints, a small remediation board (separate lane), and a weekly one-line digest to #incidents. Quick feedback?

omar: yes to separate lane. Our current board mixes operational tasks and remediations and things get lost. Recommend fields: owner, due_epoch, severity, recurrence_tag, blocked_by (opt).

tess: also add a compact lifecycle field: status={open, in_progress, blocked, verified, closed} and closure_reason={fix/deferred/duplicate}. That helps metrics.

ben: for reminders: 7d & 1d before due -> ping owner; if owner hasn't updated 48h after assignment -> ping shepherd. We should also auto-create 30/60/90 checkpoint comments on the card.

oncall-bot: Automation proposal received: reminders(7d,1d), shepherd_nudge(48h). Pending approval.

rachel: rotation idea: IC weekly, remediation-shepherd 2-week staggered so shepherds overlap for continuity. New IC shadows outgoing IC for 48h so context transfers.

omar: data model detail: store first_seen_epoch and last_update_epoch to compute recurrence windows. recurrence_score = count(similar_incidents in last_90d). We'll use >1 as a signal.

tess: UI: show recurrence_score badge and a heatmap by service. Also allow filter: type=remediation & recurrence_score>1 & open>21d.

ben: comms cadence: short Monday 09:00 digest with 3 bullets: top 3 overdue remediations, any new recurring patterns, and blockers requiring exec attention. One-line per item, link to card.

rachel: sample remediation card template I'll add to the board: ```action: brief summary
owner: @user
due_epoch: 1700000000
severity: P1/P2
type: remediation
recurrence_tag: infra|config|process|3rd_party
first_seen_epoch: 1700000100
last_update_epoch: 1700000200
blocked_by: ticket#123 or none
closure_reason: 
status: open
```

omar: include followup_checkpoints array? If that's hard in the board, auto-create empty comments with timestamps for 30/60/90 and populate when updated. That should be searchable.

tess: pilot suggestion: run for 6 weeks on two critical services (auth, db). Backfill existing remediations for pilot and compute baseline metrics: avg_time_open, closed_by_due_pct, recurrence_trend.

ben: alert rule: open>21d && recurrence_score>=2 -> page oncall lead and post summary to #incidents. Helps catch stale persistent issues.

oncall-bot: Created pilot tasks: https://redwood/tasks/5122 (board + template), https://redwood/tasks/5123 (dashboard queries), https://redwood/tasks/5124 (digest config).

rachel: volunteers: Omar will own recurrence scoring & alerts, Tess will build the board template + backfill, Ben will author the digest copy and schedule, I'll update the oncall handbook and shepherd policy. We'll reconvene next Tue for sync.

omar: quick nit: use epoch for dates so dashboards sort correctly and we can compute windows without timezone pain.

tess: noted. I'll add blocked_eta free-text for external vendor/legal blockers so shepherds can escalate with an ETA.

ben: on digest wording keep it 3 lines max. Execs prefer one actionable sentence + link. Example line: "Auth: 2 overdue remediations (see board) — request: vendor ticket ETA."

rachel: approved. Action summary for pilot rollout: 
- tess: board template + backfill by Fri
- omar: recurrence_score + alerts by Thu
- ben: digest template + schedule by Thu
- rachel: update handbook + shepherd role doc by next Mon

oncall-bot: Pilot kickoff scheduled for Monday. Opt-in required for services.

rachel: Thanks all. Goal is to reduce remediation slippage and make recurring patterns visible before they reoccur. We'll post progress each week here.
